title: The Open Landfall
author: Ansel Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Delacroix, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
